Pose - Action Mid-Leap.description:
🕴️ Pose: Action Mid-Leap
Captured mid-jump — airborne, dynamic, with the body fully extended in action.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Action Mid-Leap.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, show frame-visible airborne motion through a lifted torso, bent or extended visible limbs, and controlled momentum. Do not force Full Body, reveal anatomy outside the crop, or change camera distance. Show ground clearance only when the selected frame includes it. Female: the torso lengthens and the shoulders trail the lift. Male: the shoulders drive the lift and stay set. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own airborne line.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
